messages:
alex: heads up — infra perf alert from prod canary: flashv2 is picking the slow SDPA path for causal requests when head_dim == 30 and seq_len ~ 8, microbatching 4. latency +30% vs baseline. repro attached in logs.
priya: ugh. is this only on SM86 or seen elsewhere? any KV-cache involvement?
alex: only observed on SM86 pool so far. KV cache usage is high (many short prefix requests) and we see L2 spill warnings in the kernel logs. looks like tile choice + head mod arithmetic triggers fallback.
jonathan: ran perf on a local repro. flame graph shows hot path: sdpa_v2->tile_select->causal_copier. Occupancy drops when head_dim % 8 != 0 (30 here). snippet: ```
# molten profile
sdpa_v2 kernel  45% @ 12ms
tile_select     20% @ 5ms
causal_copy     18% @ 4.5ms
```
jonathan: also saw many short-lived kernel launches with tiny warps due to microbatching (batch_size 4). likely latency dominated by kernel launch overhead + L2 spill.
priya: can we force v3 or v1 for that shape as a temporary mitigation? autotuner should have a rule but maybe the threshold is off.
alex: tried forcing v3, that helps ~10% but still worse than expected. v3 path uses larger shared memory and avoids some copies but on SM86 shared mem pressure causes other slowdowns.
leah: thinking aloud — maybe the autotuner uses a sequence-length threshold but doesn't consider head_dim oddities + kv-cache presence. we should add a heuristic: if is_causal && head_dim % 8 != 0 && kv_cache_active && seq_len <= 16 -> prefer v1 (or a patched v2 variant)
leah: proposed patch (very small): ```
// in kernel_picker.cpp
if (is_causal && kv_cache && (head_dim % 8) != 0 && seq_len <= 16) {
  prefer_kernel = KernelKind::FlashV1;
}
```
jonathan: +1 to heuristic, but prefer gating behind a feature flag and metric so we can rollback. we should also add a microbatching-aware cost term: cost += launch_overhead * microbatch_count.
priya: agree. can we add a quick perf test in the autotuner CI that runs head_dim=30, seq_len=8, kv_cache=true on an SM86 runner? catches regressions.
alex: started a canary job with the heuristic enabled on 1% of traffic. infra-bot will post results.
infra-bot: :robot_face: Canary job 1962104321-ct started on pool sm86-canary-3, keeping 1% traffic. Duration 2h. Link: https://ci.internal/canaries/1962104321-ct
priya: also add telemetry tag to kernel decisions so we can see frequency of this rule (e.g., kernel_pick:flashv1_reason=headmod_kv_short).
leah: added a follow-up to my PR: will add feature flag + telemetry + unit test for head_dim odd cases.
jonathan: FYI I captured a perf trace and attached a minimal repro script: ```python
# repro snippet
model = load('tiny')
for _ in range(200):
  req = make_request(seq_prefix=6, gen_len=2, head_dim=30, kv_cache=True)
  client.call(req)
```
alex: perfect. thanks all. if canary looks good we'll roll to 25% and then full. filing followup perf ticket with logs and flame snapshots. :thumbsup:
priya: nice root cause discovery. once stable let's also add a note to runtime docs about head_dim alignment gotchas.
leah: will do. closing here unless someone has objections.
